title: NntpQueue DKIM failure loops forever: no dead-letter path
description: In queue.rs drain_once, DKIM signing failure does 'continue' to defer the article. Ed25519 signing is a pure local crypto op — it cannot transiently succeed after a permanent failure (e.g. corrupt key material). Every drain cycle the same article hits the same DKIM failure, emitting a warn log on every cycle indefinitely. Unlike SmtpRelayQueue which moves DKIM failures to dead/, NntpQueue has no dead-letter path. Trigger: any article in the NntpQueue when dkim_signer is Some and signer.sign() returns Err. Bad behavior: infinite retry loop, log spam, article never delivered or retired.
